message:
The six depiction gaps say nothing about the digging and carrying design because the missing folding arms, misplaced chain and hopper leaders, duplicated discharge and wheel labels, and unlabeled packs all contradict connections already fixed in the narrow-kerf sketch (E65) and the side-view digger to hopper sketch (E13).

For cutting, Black Point-1 (BP-1), meaning lunar basalt simulant, stays diggable within traction because the narrow 100 mm kerf slot at 50 mm depth needs far less draft than a full-width cut and leaves side spoil for the wide ladder to lift. The kerf cut force scaling (E64) at 11.0 N versus the traction in the tip-over and stopping check (E23) at 294 N is about the weight of a 1-kg bag of sugar pulling against a grown person's shove, so margin is large; Manager and Mobility and Deployable Chassis Lead, this keeps the entry tooth load below slip.

For carrying, the steep-wall wedge hopper volume sets trip size inside the robot mass limit because running half-full keeps wheel load and tip moment down while still moving soil. The hopper payload from 20 L volume (E10) at 30.0 kg max run at 15.0 kg trips with the hopper filling simulation (E11) at 112 s to 15.0 kg is like carrying one airline checked bag per trip, inside the updated mass sum with stiffened frame (E62) at 46.0 kg versus 60.0 kg; Power Structure and Integration Lead and Autonomy and Blind Operations Lead, this is why the fill stop stays at half-full.

For dumping, the pour stays controlled over the bin lip because the short screw meters flow during tilt rather than slumping as one slug. The outlet area for 150 mm diameter (E69) at 0.0177 m2 with the dump clearance in the tip dump clearance check (E51) at 0.150 m over a 0.400 m lip is about a soup-can hole clearing a kerb, so blind alignment by the bin fiducial holds; the ladder power from cut force (E59) at 16.4 W already fits the pack.

Position: ready, because excavation force, volume, and pour control all survive with margin and the depiction errors need only leader and bracket correction with no redesign.
